profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is Telehouse's New York Teleport facility, part of a group of interconnected Telehouse data centers in the New York metro area forming a major internet exchange and carrier hub for the northeastern United States. Telehouse is a carrier neutral colocation provider and a subsidiary of KDDI Corporation, one of Japan's largest telecommunications companies. Telehouse has continued expanding its US footprint through acquisition, including KDDI's roughly one billion dollar purchase of Allied Properties' Canadian and US data center portfolio. Telehouse markets its facilities on dense interconnection, meet me room access, and proximity to major network peering points, positioning it alongside operators like Equinix and CoreSite in the New York colocation market. No specific critical IT megawattage figure for this facility was found published on Telehouse own site. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
